title: Workflow Engine Redundancy
opponent_argument: Temporal, Cadence, and Airflow already solve durable state, retries, and task execution for distributed systems.
evidence_for_objection: Enterprise agents widely use Temporal/Step Functions; 70% of production workflows are deterministic DAGs.
program_response: Temporal solves deterministic execution; it lacks primitives for non-deterministic model planning, prompt injection boundaries, capability discovery, and authority attenuation.

title: Frontier Model Sufficiency
opponent_argument: Next-generation reasoning models internally plan and retain constraints, making external contracts redundant.
evidence_for_objection: Scaling test-time compute reduces plan drift on benchmark reasoning tasks.
program_response: Intelligence is not authority or independent evidence. Empirical tests (JAR-EXP-0001/0004) showed frontier models still produce 50% false completion without independent verifiers.

title: Control Plane Tax Unviability
opponent_argument: Adding formal policies, verification agents, and evidence logging multiplies token cost by 3-5x, making systems economically unviable.
evidence_for_objection: High-assurance agent prototypes cost $0.45 per task vs $0.05 for baseline agents.
program_response: Empirically refuted in STUDY-003: Progressive disclosure caps CPT at 1.6% and automated recovery reduces Cost Per Verified Outcome by 81.3%.

title: Conversational Chat Primacy
opponent_argument: End users prefer natural language conversation over reviewing structured mission contracts and acceptance criteria.
evidence_for_objection: Consumer chat interfaces dominate user engagement across AI products.
program_response: Chat is ideal for exploratory discovery but causes high cognitive fatigue in multi-hour autonomous tasks. Exception-first 'Needs You' UX is superior for delegation.

title: Standards Proliferation (XKCD 927)
opponent_argument: Introducing a new contract creates another competing standard in a fragmented landscape.
evidence_for_objection: Ecosystem fatigue over competing manifest formats and config schemas.
program_response: SPEC-001 is strictly compositional: it reuses MCP, SPIFFE, C2PA, RFC 8693, and OTel without reinventing plumbing.

title: Schema Complexity Harms Small Models
opponent_argument: Injecting full systems manifests will thrash context windows and destroy performance of local 7B models.
evidence_for_objection: 7B models have limited context windows and weak nested JSON parsing.
program_response: Addressed and proven via progressive disclosure (SPEC-001 Tier 1 <= 300 tokens): 7B model CUA improved from 43% to 76.9% while interference dropped to 2%.

title: Retry Confounder Objection
opponent_argument: Observed VSR improvements are merely caused by granting retries rather than evidence gating.
evidence_for_objection: Standard retry loops improve baseline agent pass@k metrics.
program_response: Empirically refuted in STUDY-005: Baselines with retries truncate at attempt 1 (mean attempts 1.13) due to false completions in 34% of runs; evidence gating is the causal enabler of retries.
